answer: Transactions & Dealings >> Other Transactions Question ID: 5851 Country: India Title: My brother owns a building space which he intends to rent out. Can he rent it to a bank for conducting its business. Since banks deal in interest for SB accounts and loans etc., he wants to know whether the rent received from bank is halal. Question: My brother owns a building space which he intends to rent out. Can he rent it to a bank for conducting its business. Since banks deal in interest for SB accounts and loans etc., he wants to know whether the rent received from bank is halal. Answer ID: 5851 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 404/404=M/1429) When you know it already that banks do interest-based transactions and their system is based on interest, then it is not correct to rent a building to bank, since helping in sin is sin, as Allah Almighty says: ولاتعاونوا ع لی الإثم و العدوان (سورة مائده) Your brother should rent the building to one doing lawful business . Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
